articles.title: BlackRock and Fidelity are quietly turning bitcoin ETFs into a two-firm market
articles.snippet: BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC are attracting the vast majority of new bitcoin ETF money, leaving smaller funds increasingly sidelined as institutional investors consolidate around the industry's largest players.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto calls on members to campaign against banks blocking digital asset transactions
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK is telling its members to file formal complaints with high-street banks over sector-wide transfer bans.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Who answers the 3am call when DeFi breaks?
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Ben Nadareski writes that to win over big investors, DeFi builders must act like accountable money managers, not just software developers. Then, Stephen Stonberg says that bitcoin holders can survive crashes and protect their assets by earning income through reinsurance.

articles.title: Netomi CEO says $5 trillion AI customer experience market could boost stablecoin demand
articles.snippet: Puneet Mehta, a former high-level Wall Street engineer and data scientist, said the rapid expansion of AI enterprise software will increase demand for stablecoins and blockchain.

articles.title: The quantum clock is ticking: it's Bitcoin's problem, not Ethereum's
articles.snippet: A recent research note published by Citi analysts reached a conclusion about quantum risk that should give every institutional bitcoin holder pause, Tabar explains.
